_about: What the PRODUCTION server is told when it is deployed (tools/production-env.cjs turns this into functions/.env and refuses anything unsafe). Production reads Joe's real Uniontown sheets: the Live workbook UDPO LIVE DATA - UNIONTOWN, Route, Driver, Equipment and Users Master, day offs and vacations, and the Plant Operations workbook (the IDs are in functions/src/sources.js, the same as the current app). It writes to one sheet only: dispatch changes go to the real Uniontown Live workbook (WRITEBACK_JSON; Joe 10/12: "Let the new app write dispatch changes to the real Live sheet."), and only once an administrator turns the write-back on in the app. production-env.cjs refuses any other target, and functions/src/writeback.js refuses every other production sheet in code. Email goes to the people it is meant for (LIVE_EMAIL=1; Joe 10/14: "No, I want the new email to be live. It's ready. ... IT department has already cleared everything."); the Sending switch in Administration > Sent Email Log stops all email at once. Reports are emailed as MAIL_FROM; REPORT_TO (the plant managers) stays empty until Joe names them, so until then a report goes only to the person who pressed Send. Schedule Texts (LIVE_TEXTS=1; Joe 10/15 "have everything ready but not implemented just yet ... put something in administration to keep it off") can text drivers only once an administrator saves the Twilio account and turns them On in Administration > Schedule Texts; they start Off.
